PRIYA IYER
Chennai, India | priya.iyer97@gmail.com | +91 91234 56780
linkedin.com/in/priyaiyer | github.com/priyaiyer
Profile Summary
B.Tech graduate interested in applied machine learning and data-driven products. Comfortable working across the ML lifecycle, from cleaning data to evaluating model performance.
Skills
Languages: Python, SQL
ML/DL: Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, Pandas, NumPy
Experience
Data & AI Intern — Loopwave Technologies
Jan 2025 – Mar 2025 | Chennai
Cleaned and prepared customer feedback data for a sentiment analysis model used by the product team.
Trained a basic sentiment classifier and presented findings to a small internal stakeholder group.
Created a Streamlit dashboard to let non-technical teammates explore model outputs.
Projects
Movie Recommendation Mini-Project
Built a content-based movie recommender using cosine similarity on a public dataset, as a personal learning project.
Wrote a short blog post explaining the approach, shared with a small number of peers.
Education
B.Tech Information Technology
SSN College of Engineering, Chennai | 2021 – 2025 | CGPA: 7.5/10
Certifications
IBM Python for Data Science (Coursera)
